title: External vs. Internal Conflict — Does Your Story Need Both?
skills: distinguish internal conflict from external conflict
analyze how different conflicts shape character choices
evaluate how conflict contributes to plot and tension
use internal and external conflict in narrative writing
alignment_note: Compares internal and external conflict and examines how each contributes to character development, plot, and narrative tension. Supports literary analysis and creative writing by helping students recognize and intentionally use multiple forms of conflict across high school English courses.
